title: Next Retail Supplier Cyber Incident
description: Next warned that hackers gained access to limited data through a technology supplier. Customer personal data not compromised.

title: Samsung Securities Customer Data Exposure
description: Exposed personal information of 8,241 customers including names, account numbers and driver's licence numbers.

title: Cleverbridge Payment Card Data Breach
description: Third-party access to stored payment card data including card numbers and CVVs.
impact: Payment card data of customers exposed.

title: KEPCO Customer Platform Breach
description: Personal data of about 1.52 million users leaked from customer platform and e-procurement system.

title: Binance Hot Wallet Theft
description: Approximately $6.3 billion drained from hot wallets; compromised engineer workstation suspected.

title: ARARA Email Delivery Service Breach
description: Up to 81.3 million email addresses leaked from Japanese email delivery platform serving ~380 clients.
impact: Massive email address exposure across clients.

title: Nitori Holdings Customer Records Breach
description: Up to 37.62 million customer records may have leaked; names, emails, addresses, phones.

title: DentaQuest Data Breach
description: Largest confirmed healthcare breach of 2026; ~15 million people affected.

title: Bybit Ethereum Cold Wallet Theft
description: Lazarus Group drained ~$1.46 billion in ETH from cold wallet via Safe{Wallet} UI compromise. Largest crypto theft at the time.

title: Change Healthcare Ransomware & Data Breach
description: 2024 ALPHV ransomware; confirmed 192.7 million people affected — largest US healthcare breach ever. Disrupted claims nationwide.

title: Conduent Business Services Breach
description: Access from Oct 2024–Jan 2025; ~62.2 million people affected. Files for healthcare and government clients stolen.
impact: Third-largest US healthcare breach; government services impacted.

title: Aflac Data Breach
description: ~22.65 million people notified; SSNs, health info, medical records exposed.
impact: Large insurance PHI and PII exposure.

title: Yale New Haven Health System Breach
description: 5.56 million individuals affected.

title: Episource Data Breach
description: Ransomware; 6.7 million people affected (health plans).

title: Blue Shield of California Breach
description: 4.7 million individuals affected via website tracking tools.

title: Jaguar Land Rover Cyberattack
description: Production halted for weeks; estimated £1.9–2.2bn economic impact.

title: Marks & Spencer Ransomware
description: Disrupted operations and payments; losses estimated £300–405m; customer data stolen.

title: Salesloft Drift / Salesforce Supply-Chain Attack
description: UNC6395 used compromised OAuth tokens from Drift integration to access Salesforce data at 700+ organizations including security firms.
impact: Widespread CRM and credential theft via supply chain.

title: Oracle EBS Zero-Day & Cloud Breaches
description: Cl0p and others exploited Oracle EBS and earlier Cloud identity systems; hundreds of organizations affected.

title: F5 BIG-IP Source Code Theft
description: Nation-state actors stole BIG-IP source code and undisclosed vulnerability info after long-term access.
impact: Elevated risk for F5 customers worldwide.

title: SK Telecom Subscriber Breaches
description: Nearly 27 million subscribers affected; risks of SIM cloning and identity theft.

title: Qantas Customer Data Breach
description: ~5.7 million customer records stolen via Salesforce platform; later leaked.

title: Asahi Group Ransomware
description: Disrupted industrial and logistics systems; data stolen.

title: PowerSchool Student Data Breach
description: Tens of millions of US K-12 students and teachers; SSNs, grades, medical info.

title: St. Paul MN Ransomware
description: City systems offline; data accessed; weeks of disruption.

title: Coupang Data Breach
description: Nearly 34 million customer records exposed.

title: DaVita Patient Data Breach
description: 2.7 million patients; SSNs, insurance, clinical records.

title: SimonMed Imaging Cyberattack
description: 1.27 million patients and 212GB data exfiltrated.

title: French Supermarket Refrigeration Attack
description: Refrigeration controllers at ~700 supermarkets switched to defrost; France attributed to Iran-linked actors.

title: Bitget Cryptocurrency Hack
description: ~$388 million drained via zero-day in third-party security products.

title: Denmark CPR Register Breach
description: Personal information of 8.8 million registered citizens exposed via misused access.

title: Pentagon DMDC Personnel Data Breach
description: Over 3 million DoD personnel records exposed.

title: CenterPoint Energy Data Theft
description: Customer data including SSNs via API; over 1 million Texans affected.

title: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Partner Access
description: Unauthorized access to ScreenConnect partner accounts; third-party extensions suspected.

title: Vanderbilt University Systems Restricted
description: Cyber incident restricted most systems; full restoration may take weeks.

title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Bank Heist
description: ~€100–118 million transferred via compromised third-party provider.

title: Capcom ID Data Breach
description: Over 11.7 million customer email addresses and account metadata exposed.

title: IDCF Cloud Ransomware Attack
description: Ransomware took down cloud region affecting 495 companies and local governments.

title: SBC Medical Group Data Breach
description: Personal and treatment records of 1.62 million people extracted.

title: FBI NCIC Database Intrusion Investigation
description: Apparent breach of National Crime Information Center investigated.

title: USDA Farm Payment Systems Incident
description: Outages of farmer payment, loan and crop insurance systems.

title: Optimizely Experimentation Supply-Chain Attack
description: Malicious JS injected into 178 organizations' sites including major media.
impact: Card skimming and malware delivery via trusted scripts.

title: Equinor Cyberattack
description: IT systems attacked; oil/gas production unaffected.

title: Rakuten Securities Customer Data Leak
description: Possible exposure of login IDs for 11.25M accounts and sensitive data for 4.47M.

title: Harvard University Alumni Data Breach
description: ~850,500 unique accounts exposed via phishing; alumni and donor data.

title: TransUnion Data Breach
description: ~4.46 million people affected.

title: University of Phoenix Data Breach
description: ~3.49 million people affected.

title: Collins Aerospace Check-in System Attack
description: Ransomware on vMUSE passenger processing; check-in outages at Heathrow, Brussels, Berlin, Dublin.

title: Kering Group (Gucci etc.) Data Breach
description: 7.4 million customer files from luxury brands exposed.

title: Red Hat Consulting GitLab Breach
description: 570 GB of data including customer engagement reports exfiltrated.
